starterQuestions.label: What did you build at SastraAI?
និយាយភាសាខ្មែរ

sastra.text: I co-founded SastraAI, an AI tutor for math and science students in Cambodia's bilingual and EMI schools. I worked on the React web and mobile frontend, and led parent surveys and our B2B2C go-to-market plan.

stack.text: JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python and AWS (I'm an AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner). At my internship I used React, TypeScript, Ant Design and UmiJS.

open.text: Yes! I'm looking for an internship or graduate program. The fastest way to reach the real me is the contact form.

khmer.text: ចាស! ខ្ញុំអាចឆ្លើយជាភាសាខ្មែរបាន។ សួរខ្ញុំអំពីគម្រោង ឬបទពិសោធន៍ការងាររបស់ម៉ារីបាន។

thanks.text: អរគុណ! Thanks for stopping by.

fallback.text: This is a preview, so I can only answer the starter questions for now. On the real site I'll answer from Mary's CV, and if I don't know, I'll point you to the real Mary.

unavailable.text: I can't reach my AI brain right now. Please try again in a minute, or message the real Mary.

rateLimited.text: I'm getting a lot of questions at once. Give me a minute, or message the real Mary directly.

note: Starter chips and typed questions go to /api/chat. These scripted answers are the offline fallback when the AI endpoint fails.
